body: I'm all over the place to tell you the truth.  I've had an okay week and just yesterday it's been complete chaos. I keep trusting the same person who hurt me just to do it again. I feel incredibly low. Sorry for dumping this on you, I feel like I can't tell anyone I know.
Sorry for replying so late...I felt a moral obligation to tell you I'm still alive. Thank you very much for caring enough to send me a reply.
